description: Extract Unicode text with positioned runs (pdfnative v1.6 via extract_text). Since v1.5.0 the extractor resolves each font's /ToUnicode CMap, so subset fonts decode to real characters (not glyph indices). Pass includeRuns:true to also return per-run device-space geometry { text, x, y, fontSize, fontName } for layout-aware extraction. Encrypted PDFs work by adding a `password`. Replace <base64 from step 1> with the generated bytes.

blocks.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
